opening.argument: The discussion is framed as an investment analysis of wealth preservation and capital allocation, not as a completed transaction or a promised result. It distinguishes savings from investments, identifies Bitcoin as a benchmark for long-term evaluation, and describes holding Bitcoin in cold storage as savings. The reported historical performance is presented as a comparison with other major assets, while the speaker also acknowledges that returns remain available across stocks, real estate, and bonds. Most importantly, the speaker expressly limits the discussion: “This is not financial advice. It is for informational and educational purposes only.”

citations.quote: Savings are held in monetary assets. Investments are savings put at risk.
The correct unit of account for evaluating any long-term investment is Bitcoin.
Holding cold storage bitcoin is savings.
Bitcoin's compound annual growth rate over the last ten plus years is very significant, outpacing almost every major global asset.
This is not financial advice. It is for informational and educational purposes only.
